body:
Stephanie Nguyen: Field ask: can we get a *2-minute Hosted API mini-demo* variant? For those "intro" calls where we don’t have 20 mins for the full console walkthrough. What do we cut w/o losing differentiation?

Markus Klein: +1, I’m getting the same request. My worry: if we only do "hello world" it turns into every other API provider. We need *at least one* Redwood-specific proof point in 2 mins.

Soojin Lee: Agree. In 2 mins we can’t do: routing/fallback + rollouts + dashboards + dedicated/private narrative. We need a tight story arc.

Renee Sullivan: Proposal (2 min total):
1) 45s: curl/SDK call w/ streaming on (shows latency + devex)
2) 45s: show response includes `usage` + `model_version` (shows governance/pinning)
3) 30s: jump to Console -> "Request trace" / "Cost & latency" panel (shows observability)
Then offer: "If you want, we can show routing/fallback + Dedicated in the full demo".

Simran Kaur: Tool calling in 2 mins is risky (more moving parts, more chance of a weird model response). Streaming chat is safest + it’s a visceral moment.

Colin O'Donnell: If we do console at all, we need a clickpath that’s 2 clicks max. Like a saved view.
- Console -> Demo Tenant -> Dashboards -> "Hosted API: Last 15m"
- highlight p50 latency + $/1k tokens
Everything else is a rabbit hole.

Nikhil Sharma: What differentiation do we want to claim in that 2 mins?
- “Same API in Hosted/Dedicated/Private” is hard to prove live quickly.
- “Production-grade controls” is easier: show streaming + usage accounting + rate limits + dashboards.
We should avoid: deep performance claims / competitive comparisons.

Stephanie Nguyen: Exactly. The ask is basically: "show me it works and it’s not a science project".
Also: we need a mini-demo that an AE can run without SE heroics.

Markus Klein: For that reason: no live editing configs. No live canary rollouts. No routing rule changes. Just run the canned request + show the dashboard.

Lukas Meyer: EMEA add: can we include a one-liner on regions/data residency? Even if it’s just "hosted is multi-region" and "EU-only routing available in Dedicated/Private".

Soojin Lee: For mini-demo, I’d keep it as a verbal sidebar only. If we try to click into region routing in-console it’ll blow the time.

Talia Benson: Can we document this as an official branch in the talk track? If it’s going to the field, it needs a single source of truth.

Renee Sullivan: I can draft a "2-min Hosted" section as a talk track insert + add a checklist.
Also: we should have a Plan B:
- pre-captured response text in notes
- screenshot/GIF of the dashboard panel
If streaming disconnects mid-call, we don’t want to flail.

Colin O'Donnell: Concrete suggestion for the canned request:
- Keep prompt deterministic-ish (summarize a fixed paragraph / rewrite)
- Use a pinned model in the demo tenant (no "latest")
- Use low temperature
We can show the request is identical every time.

Simran Kaur: +1. Also avoid prompts that invite policy/refusal edge cases.

Markus Klein: What’s the "Redwood moment" though? Streaming alone isn’t unique.

Nikhil Sharma: The "Redwood moment" could be: *token-level accounting* + *observability in-console* within seconds. Many folks can stream; fewer can show per-request trace, tokens, latency breakdown without extra setup.

Soojin Lee: Exactly. The narrative is:
- "Call the API"
- "Get streaming output"
- "Immediately see cost/latency + request trace" (and mention: same tooling works across Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
That’s a clean differentiator.

Stephanie Nguyen: Works for me. What do we cut explicitly so people don’t try to jam everything in?

Markus Klein: Cut list for mini-demo:
- no routing/fallback
- no rollouts/canary/A-B
- no Dedicated capacity/SLA deep dive
- no Private/VPC architecture slide
If asked, we *offer* the full demo or a follow-up deep dive.

Renee Sullivan: I’ll write it as:
- "2-min Hosted mini-demo" (default)
- "10-min Hosted + Console" (if they lean technical)
- "Full Standard Demo" (20–25 min)
So it’s a choose-your-own-adventure.

Lukas Meyer: Please include a single "if asked" line for EMEA: "We can run the same API endpoint in EU regions / EU-only routing in Dedicated/Private." Keep it clean.

Colin O'Donnell: Implementation detail: I can create a saved dashboard view called "MINI DEMO - Hosted (2m)" so the clickpath is idiot-proof.

Simran Kaur: Also let’s ensure quotas don’t bite us. Mini-demo should never 429.

Markus Klein: @Colin O'Donnell can you coordinate with @Cole Summers on demo tenant rate limit defaults? If an AE runs this back-to-back, we don’t want throttles.

Colin O'Donnell: Yep, will do.

Stephanie Nguyen: Great. Action items?

Talia Benson: Capturing:
- Renee: draft the 2-min talk track insert + Plan B assets
- Colin: create "MINI DEMO - Hosted (2m)" saved dashboard view + confirm clickpath
- Soojin: add a note in deck speaker notes: when to use mini-demo vs full
- Markus/Stephanie: pilot it in next dry run and report timing

Soojin Lee: I’ll also add a warning in the notes: "Do not live-navigate to Routes/Rollouts in the mini-demo." People can’t help themselves :)

Renee Sullivan: I’ll share a doc link once drafted. Target EOD tomorrow.

Stephanie Nguyen: :thumbsup: Thanks all. This is going to help a ton for inbound/demo-heavy weeks.
